question: Where within the body is the great goddess said to dwell?
premises: Multiple body parts are named in sequence.
The goddess is described as dwelling in them.
The description forms a single epithet of residence.
inference: The goddess is affirmed to dwell throughout the principal parts of the body.
uncertainties: The exact identification of jyeṣṭhāṅga in this bodily sequence is uncertain.
plain_english: She dwells in the chief limb, arm, heart, back, hip, and foot.
